from cachekit import LRUCache


def test_rewritten_key_survives_eviction():
    cache = LRUCache(capacity=2)
    cache.put('a', 1)
    cache.put('b', 2)
    cache.put('a', 3)
    cache.put('c', 4)
    assert 'a' in cache
